source: viscous Burgers, exact solution (Cole-Hopf, 120-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature)

protocol.metric_definition: relative L2 error per held-out field, averaged
protocol.stopping: iterative methods: until the budget is spent, best of 10 validation checkpoints (evaluation time not charged); one-shot fits: fitted once, time reported
protocol.equal_data: one split shared by every method and seed; the model seed varies, the data does not
protocol.hyperparameters: each method's defaults in pinneapple_analysis.surrogate.methods; no per-method search
